pages.title: Home
pages.description: The hub that sets the scene for the conference and compels visitors to secure their spot.

sections.intent: Set the tone with the conference name, date, location, and a bold visual of the stage or crowd.
sections.reason: A banner gives events teams an immediate sense of the conference scale and atmosphere, anchoring the brand the moment they land.

sections.intent: Push the primary 'Register' action with urgency (early-bird deadline or limited capacity).
sections.reason: The brief’s sole CTA is registration; a dedicated hero-level CTA ensures the highest traffic page converts the moment interest peaks.

sections.intent: Surface three key differentiators (e.g., track count, top-tier speakers, interactive workshops).
sections.reason: Events teams evaluate conferences on standout value; featured cards let them scan proof points without scrolling through dense copy.

sections.intent: Summarize the conference narrative: the theme, the tracks, and the promise of actionable takeaways.
sections.reason: A concise text block bridges the emotional pull of the banner with practical detail, addressing both the aspirational and logistical mindsets of event managers.

pages.title: Agenda
pages.description: A day-by-day layout of sessions, tracks, and breaks so organizers can judge the flow of the event.

sections.intent: Present a structured, multi-day schedule with time slots, concurrent tracks, and session titles.
sections.reason: A single text-driven grid is the clearest way for time-conscious events teams to map their own agenda and spot sessions relevant to their planning responsibilities.

pages.title: Speakers
pages.description: A showcase of headliners and session leads, with credentials that matter to event professionals.

sections.intent: Display speaker headshots in a clean, browsable grid with name, role, and topic on hover.
sections.reason: A gallery matches the visual scanning behaviour of an events team vetting credibility—faces and affiliations build trust faster than paragraphs.

pages.title: Venue
pages.description: Everything an attendee needs to arrive prepared: the venue, travel tips, and on-site services.

sections.intent: Share the venue address, map, transport links, and a contact for accessibility or dietary queries.
sections.reason: Logistics are a decisive factor for busy events professionals; a contact section bundles all arrival and access information into one actionable block.
